title: Canonical comparison and restriction map for a single open on a tail
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $W\subseteq O\subseteq X$ opens with $W$ quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ an inverse diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with affine transitions, and $c$ a limiting cone with point $T$ and projections $f_i:T\to D_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Give abelian étale sheaves $F_i$ on $D_i$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] and maps $\varphi_a:D(a^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ for $a:i\to j$, satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $G:I\to\mathrm{Ab}(T_{\acute et})$ have specified isomorphisms $eG_i:G_i\cong f_i^{-1}F_i$ and arrows conjugate to inverse-image composition followed by $f_j^{-1}\varphi_a$. Let $L$ be a colimit cocone of $G$. Give $H:I\to\mathrm{Ab}$ with isomorphisms $eH_i:H_i\cong H^0(D_i,F_i)$ whose arrows are conjugate to cohomology pullback followed by $H^0(\varphi_a)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Give a cocone $B$ of $H$ and $eB:B_{\mathrm{pt}}\cong H^0(T,L_{\mathrm{pt}})$ such that $B_i$ followed by $eB$ equals $eH_i$ followed by $f_i^*$ and $H^0(eG_i^{-1}\mathbin{;}L_i)$. Fix $i_0\in I$, $e:D_{i_0}\cong O$, and a predicate $P$ on schemes with $P(W)$.

Put $J=I_{\ge i_0}$ with inclusion $t:J\to I$, $g_j:D_j\to D_{i_0}\xrightarrow e O\to X$, $W_j=g_j^{-1}(W)$, and $W_L=(T\to D_{i_0}\xrightarrow e O\to X)^{-1}(W)$. Let $B_W=H^0(W_L,L_{\mathrm{pt}}|_{W_L})$ and $r_W:B_{\mathrm{pt}}\to B_W$ be $eB$ followed by restriction. There exist $K:J\to\mathrm{Ab}$, isomorphisms $eK_j:K_j\cong H^0(W_j,F_j|_{W_j})$, a natural transformation $r:t\mathbin{\star}H\to K$, and $v:\operatorname{colim}K\to B_W$ such that: $r_j$ followed by $eK_j$ is $eH_j$ followed by restriction; $v$ has a stage-cohomology comparison certificate for $P$ [def-weil-pbc-stage-cohomology-comparison]; and $r_j\mathbin{;}\iota_j\mathbin{;}v=B_j\mathbin{;}r_W$ for every $j$. No injectivity or binary-product assertion is made.

source.place: Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), restriction of coherent systems to inverse-image opens; cohomology functoriality as in Tag 01F7.

proof.text: Use the directed tail above i₀. Transfer W into O and then D(i₀), and pull it back to each tail stage and the limit. The opens cone is limiting and all its transitions and projections are affine. Compactness of W and quasi-separatedness give qcqs restricted stages; the least tail stage is isomorphic to W.toScheme.

Restrict F and its transition maps. The inverse-image composition comparisons give their identity and composition laws, as well as the restricted G identifications and arrow formula. Final reindexing preserves the given colimit, and restriction preserves it because inverse image is a left adjoint.

Construct the canonical degree-zero cohomology diagram on this restricted system. Its object identifications give eK. Apply the system certificate constructor with the least stage W.toScheme, and transport the codomain using the open-limit and coefficient identifications. Cohomology pullback functoriality and coefficient naturality give r with the stated component formula; the canonical cocone equation and hB give the stage-leg equation.
